corrections.reason: The printed glyph in the image has the 2nd-order (ካዕብ) stroke on the right side of ኀ, reading ወአብዝኁ (plural verb matching በዝኁ አርዳኢሁ in line 7 and the Amharic translation አብዝተው እንዳጠመቁ in line 13).
The final character has the two legs of ሴ (ዘሴ = ዘኢያሱ / Book of Joshua 24:32, the canonical cross-reference for Jacob's parcel of ground in Shechem), not the single-legged ሌ.
The printed character is clearly ፅ (with the circular head of ፀ), reading አፅቀ በለስ, not ጽ.
The printed character is clearly ፅ (with the circular head of ፀ), reading አፅቀ በለሱን, not ጽ.
